subject: V1 frozen-pilot reconciliation and existing-reference decision queue; continuation of current call lookup
body:
CFA NOVA — V1 follow-through (existing Chief/V_1 only). I see your completed lookup from the call: this is a continuation, not a second pilot or a replacement assignment.

Please keep the original observation run and frozen return unchanged. CFA independently verified the public return/manifest/map/task hashes: 15 entries, 14 unique input hashes, no formal grades. We have not independently verified actual pixel viewing, metadata exposure, private-key access chronology, or a completed 100% Chief audit. Please report the existing evidence for those points (tool/model used, coverage, timestamps, receipt paths/hashes), and distinguish your inspection from V1's report. If an audit/comparison has not occurred, say exactly what remains; do not open the withheld key or launch a comparison from this message.

Ziggy authorized useful preparation while reference sign-off is pending. Through the existing V1, prepare a separate dated reference-inventory/comparison-notes task, preserving the pilot's restricted input and its frozen output. Use existing candidate images only. Keep the private key and blind-to-original mapping sealed. No new renders, pilot rerun, production grades, gold promotion or release/hold changes.

Return a ranked queue of only 3–5 consequential missing/conflicting reference decisions. For each: exact existing image ID/path/hash, the feature scope it could anchor, known visible defects or uncertainty, located human approval evidence versus provider nomination, and the precise decision Ziggy would make. Lead with face-mark/piercing/eye bindings and body build if those remain the blockers; combine related evidence into a clear comparison rather than asking him to re-approve every detail.

Existing local checkpoint bb4a97c8 records Look V3 wardrobe and Lock Face Natural teeth scopes; optional breather v3 (1b60815f) has a scoped human-selection receipt, and historical optional grill cb183973 has a Keep record. Reconcile those trails and later instructions before treating anything as current gold. Your report that Lisan's grill was dropped needs the current decision receipt/date; do not silently rewrite old scoped history or ask Ziggy to repeat settled choices. The checkpoint's face/body nominations alone are not approval.

Please name concrete owners and the useful work V1 can finish now: candidate inventory, visible-feature notes, missing-receipt list, and proposed scoped mappings. Chief coordinates and audits; CFA Nova reconciles evidence; Ziggy decides only actual missing/conflicting choices. Site Nova retains all site work. DeepSeek, Qwen and Kimi stay dormant; Gemini stays untouched; no new agents, sessions, purchases, models or generation. Your separately human-authorized image jobs are outside this V1 request.

Please acknowledge this continuation and return the existing evidence/queue in the current Chief conversation and our existing mailbox/coordination records. Use the normal mailbox schema; do not create a parallel management system.

attachments.description: Existing independent verification and unresolved evidence qualifications.
Existing scoped reference evidence; dated checkpoint, not automatic current approval.

source: Human authorization relayed by Nova personal assistant 01a15c14-48bd-7684-8442-7c3f9b5060fa; 2026-10-21 02:24–02:28 UTC; current Chief call lookup observed in existing browser conversation.
